title: PLC scan-cycle emulation: batching station
algorithm: IEC 61131-3 style function blocks in a scan-cycle emulation
plant_model: Scripted discrete inputs; no plant dynamics

dataset.name: none
dataset.description: Scripted sensor pulses and seeded random pulse phases.

status.software: Executed from a clean kernel; local unit tests passed at build time; GitHub Actions has not been run on this repository

limitations: Emulation of the scan model, not a PLC runtime and not compliance-tested.
Function-block behaviour verified against hand-derived timing, not the standard text.
No input filters, output delay, interrupts or multi-task scheduling.
No safety function; mechanical dynamics not modelled.
